name: FeedAgentX – Product Feed & Pixel for ChatGPT Business Hub and ChatGPT Ads
author: feedagentx

sections.description:
A WooCommerce product feed for ChatGPT Business Hub and ChatGPT Ads, plus a free pixel for ChatGPT Ads.

This plugin connects your store to FeedAgentX, a separate service that reads your catalog, builds a product feed in OpenAI’s format, checks every product against its rules and gives each ChatGPT channel its own private feed URL.

  • ChatGPT Business Hub product feed. Business Hub is where a business claims and manages its profile in ChatGPT. Once OpenAI has verified your identity, you can add a product feed there. FeedAgentX gives you a feed URL with its own username and password; add it as a Hosted URL and Business Hub downloads it on your schedule.
  • ChatGPT Ads product feed. Product ads in OpenAI Ads Manager use a feed in the same format, from a separate FeedAgentX feed URL. Paid plans can also send title, price and availability changes through OpenAI’s Ads API, which OpenAI enables per ad account.
  • Free pixel for ChatGPT Ads. OpenAI’s Measurement Pixel and Conversions API for WooCommerce, without code and without a FeedAgentX account.

How it works

  1. Install the plugin and copy the API token from FeedAgentX → Product Feed.
  2. In a FeedAgentX account, add your store URL and the token, and wait for the first sync.
  3. Fix the validation issues FeedAgentX finds and choose the products for each channel.
  4. Create the feed URL for Business Hub, Ads or both, and add it in Business Hub or OpenAI Ads Manager with its username and password.
  5. Optional: turn on the pixel under FeedAgentX → ChatGPT Ads Pixel and send a test purchase.

What you need

  • Product feed: a FeedAgentX account. The Free plan is enough to start.
  • Business Hub: a profile with identity verification approved by OpenAI; no OpenAI Ads account. See How to add your business to ChatGPT.
  • ChatGPT Ads and the pixel: an OpenAI Ads account.

Plans

  • Free: 500 products, 1 store, one ChatGPT channel per store (Business Hub or Ads, your choice).
  • Starter, $9/month: 5,000 products, both channels, Ads API updates.
  • Growth, $19/month: 25,000 products, 3 stores, both channels, Ads API updates.

Paid plans start with a 14-day free trial; the pixel is always free. See pricing and plans and limits.

What it does not do

FeedAgentX does not create or verify your Business Hub profile, add the feed for you, create campaigns or enable checkout in ChatGPT. OpenAI decides what ChatGPT shows: no placement, recommendation or sale is guaranteed.

FeedAgentX is an independent service. It is not an official OpenAI or WooCommerce product. ChatGPT and OpenAI are trademarks of OpenAI.

External services

The plugin can use two external services. Each is off until you set it up.

1. FeedAgentX.com (product feed). The plugin makes no outbound calls for the feed. It exposes a token-protected REST API that FeedAgentX.com reads once an administrator adds the API token to a FeedAgentX account. It reads product data (titles, descriptions, prices, stock, SKUs, brands, categories, image URLs, attributes, variations), store details (site name, home URL, timezone, currency, store and target countries, policy links, return settings), feed defaults, catalog totals and software versions. No customer, order or payment data. Privacy, Terms.

2. OpenAI (pixel). Nothing is sent until an administrator turns on the pixel and saves a Pixel ID, or without marketing consent where it is required. None of it goes to FeedAgentX.

  • Browser: OpenAI’s script from https://bzrcdn.openai.com/sdk/oaiq.min.js sends the page address, product views, cart additions, checkout starts and purchases with products (IDs, names, quantities, prices), currency and order value, and sets the cookies __oppref (30 days) and __obref (365 days). With customer matching on, the order confirmation page also sends SHA-256 hashes of the billing email, phone, name and customer ID, and the billing city, region, postcode and country.
  • Server, if server purchases are on: each paid storefront order goes to https://bzr.openai.com/v1/events with its event ID, payment time, checkout URL, value, currency, products, the customer’s IP address and user agent, both cookie values and, with matching on, the same hashes and address fields. The admin test purchase sends one sample event with validate_only, without customer data.

Payment details are never sent.

OpenAI Privacy Policy, Terms of Use.

Suggested privacy-policy text is in Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide. Logs in wp-content/uploads/feedagentx-logs/ hold route names, errors and the IP of refused requests, never tokens, for 14 days by default. On Nginx, deny that path in your server block.
sections.installation: Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce 5.0+ must be active), then follow “How it works” in the description or the Get started guide. Give OpenAI the feed URL from FeedAgentX, not the plugin’s WordPress endpoints.
sections.faq:
How do I add my WooCommerce products to ChatGPT Business Hub?

Get your Business Hub profile verified by OpenAI and connect this store to FeedAgentX. There, open ChatGPT channels → Business Hub and create the feed URL. In Business Hub, add products, choose Hosted URL and enter the URL, username and password. In our test on 13 Nov 2026, Business Hub processed every row of a FeedAgentX feed added as a Hosted URL with a username and password, and offered Daily, Weekly or Every two weeks refresh. OpenAI says connecting a feed doesn’t guarantee that ChatGPT recommends your products. Full steps.

Is this a ChatGPT shopping / agentic commerce plugin? Does it enable checkout in ChatGPT?

It covers the product feed, which OpenAI’s Agentic Commerce docs describe as structured catalog data ChatGPT can use for product discovery. It does not enable checkout in ChatGPT: OpenAI says a feed does not update a cart or confirm a purchase, and checkout requires a separately enabled integration. Shoppers buy on your store.

Can I use my Google Shopping feed for ChatGPT?

OpenAI’s product feed specification has its own columns, such as item_id, url, image_url and seller_name, where a Google Merchant Center feed uses id, link and image_link. We haven’t tested a Google-format feed with OpenAI, so we can’t say whether it is accepted. FeedAgentX builds the feed in OpenAI’s format straight from WooCommerce.

Do I need an OpenAI Ads account for Business Hub?

No. OpenAI says you don’t need an Ads account to claim an eligible business. Adding products needs approved identity verification. Only ChatGPT Ads and the pixel need an Ads account.

How do I track ChatGPT Ads conversions in WooCommerce?

Create a pixel and a Conversions API key in the conversions tab of OpenAI Ads Manager and paste both under FeedAgentX → ChatGPT Ads Pixel. The plugin adds OpenAI’s Measurement Pixel (page views, product views, add to cart, checkout, purchase) and sends paid orders from your server through the Conversions API with the same event ID, so a sale is counted once. Email, phone and name are hashed first, and WP Consent API banners are followed.

Does it work outside the US?

Only partly confirmed. OpenAI’s product feed specification says the standard upload currently targets the US, and Business Hub asks which countries and currencies you sell in. In our test on 13 Nov 2026, Business Hub processed the feed of a store outside the US; we have not confirmed that shoppers outside the US see those products. For ChatGPT Ads, OpenAI decides where product ads are available.
sections.changelog:
2.5.0

  • New plugin name.
  • ChatGPT Business Hub next to ChatGPT Ads in the admin screens and readme, with its own feed URL. Free covers one ChatGPT channel of your choice; paid plans cover both.
  • New: a dismissible request for a WordPress.org review on the plugin’s own pages, and a support forum link.
  • No changes to the token, the REST API, catalog data or how the pixel works.

2.4.1

  • The Free plan now covers up to 500 products (was 25).

Older versions: see changelog.txt.
